barrier_matrix.mechanism: After actual inner effect-lock or outer recovery-gate deletion, inject directory fsync failure only after the real reservation becomes SETTLED.
barrier_matrix.asserted_boundary: Current call HOLD; durable IN_PROGRESS remains; zero BOUND does not bypass barrier; a fresh real CLI returns 75 with no new attempt/worker or changed execution/artifact/observation rows.

barrier_matrix.mechanism: A real independent peer Lake attempts reserve or require_permit while owner is IN_PROGRESS, with a genuine eligible old BOUND and another actual RESERVED permit.
barrier_matrix.asserted_boundary: Peer admission denied only during barrier; no new reservation/debit; peer row preserved; owner completes and existing permit remains usable after COMPLETE.

barrier_matrix.mechanism: Two recovery consumers on independent Lake connections; block first at actual effect-lock release after settlement.
barrier_matrix.asserted_boundary: Second HOLD; first is not poisoned; exactly one private settlement returns settled; persistent COMPLETE and no storage Stop.

barrier_matrix.mechanism: Transparent SQLite commit subclass performs a legal peer Wait append after real COMPLETE commit before owner readback.
barrier_matrix.asserted_boundary: The owner's exact result is accepted; unrelated peer history does not cause false whole-snapshot HOLD.

barrier_matrix.mechanism: Real SQLite commit boundary: IN_PROGRESS rollback, COMPLETE rollback, or actual COMPLETE commit followed by raised I/O response loss.
barrier_matrix.asserted_boundary: Each current invocation HOLD. Rollbacks retain the appropriate BOUND/IP uncertainty; committed COMPLETE is not downgraded, and a fresh CLI may recheck it without resettling when no persistent Stop exists.

barrier_matrix.mechanism: An actual pre-existing SourceLock owner occupies the recovery gate.
barrier_matrix.asserted_boundary: No takeover/age inference; owner and BOUND row preserved.
Recovery refuses without consuming caller transaction or settling.

barrier_matrix.mechanism: A real peer SQLite writer replaces IN_PROGRESS nonce before old owner final CAS.
barrier_matrix.asserted_boundary: Old owner HOLD; foreign nonce remains IN_PROGRESS; no unauthorized COMPLETE.

domain_compatibility.application: Unchanged examples.holdout.scheduling.SchedulingDomain and unchanged instance.json from the existing published acceptance application.
per_case_sequence: Public IdeaLake.insert admits a challenger producer; actual registered Domain/native worker completes and settles.

Public IdeaLake.insert admits evaluator bound to the actual producer artifact; actual evaluator worker and Domain interpretation publish artifact, observation and confirmed TERMINAL/effect, then parent crash seam exits 86 at public budget settlement entry.
Fresh actual CLI performs recovery with Domain.prepare and Domain.interpret forbidden by explicit test instrumentation.
Another fresh CLI checks idle state, again without callbacks or new native work.
domain_compatibility.crash_boundary: The evaluator is scientifically valid or invalid as parameterized, but its native action is completed with real closure and confirmed publication. No synthetic TREE_CLOSED or fabricated Domain metadata is used.
domain_compatibility.observations: Existing observation validation is preserved byte-for-byte; invalid has no ranked score. Recovery is accounting settlement, not scientific re-evaluation.
invariants: Original execution, artifact, observation and task lifecycle rows unchanged after crash
Only evaluator reservation changes BOUND to SETTLED
4,000,000,000 reserved nanoseconds remain charged per project; no unused-budget refund
Final exact COMPLETE summary names only evaluator reservation
Only two actual native READY and two original interpret events per project; recovery adds neither
domain_compatibility.instrumentation: Domain prepare/interpret and native prepare_supervised are transparent observers of actual implementations; fresh recovery test flag makes any callback an assertion failure. The child delegates unchanged parent _child_main and runner; no lifecycle, tree proof or Popen is replaced.
domain_compatibility.event_counter_caution: The parent plain-command worker_events counter is zero in Domain reports because Domain workers use native_ready/interpret instrumentation. Zero plain worker_events is not a claim of zero native executions.
domain_compatibility.limitation: Reusing the published scheduling application is a positive generic-framework compatibility test, not a new holdout, optimization result, or coverage of every Domain schema.
